code: gccm(   cause,   effect,   nbmat = NULL,   coords = NULL,   data = NULL,   libsizes = NULL,   E = 3,   trend_rm = c("cause", "effect", "none", "all"),   ... )

title: geographical convergent cross mapping — gccm
text: cause causal series (character vector). effect effect series (character vector). nbmat (optional) neighbours matrix. coords (optional) coordinates matrix. data (optional) observation data. libsizes (optional) vector library sizes use. E (optional) dimensions embedding. trend_rm (optional) Variables need remove linear trends. ... (optional) parameters passed sdsfun::spdep_nb().
